def factor_corr_smoothed_range_conditional(df):
    """Smoothed range-conditional price-volume correlation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    log_vol_chg = np.log1p(df_copy["volume"]).pct_change()
    corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).corr(log_vol_chg)
    corr = corr.fillna(0.0)
    range_ratio = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"].replace(0, np.nan)
    range_ratio = range_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    range_ratio_smooth = range_ratio.ewm(span=5, adjust=False).mean().fillna(0.0)
    range_weight = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh(range_ratio_smooth * 20.0)
    factor = corr * range_weight
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    factor.name = "factor_corr_smoothed_range_conditional"
    return factor
description: Preserves parent's core rolling price-volume correlation mechanism, which provides stable RankIC/RankICIR and payoff monotonicity. The bottleneck is noise in the daily range_ratio used as the range-weight modifier; raw intraday range can spike erratically and introduce unstable scaling. This mutation applies light exponential smoothing (span=5) to the normalized range ratio before the bounded tanh scaling, reducing estimation noise while retaining the original wide-range amplification and narrow-range attenuation logic. This targets improved ICIR and MI without changing the sign interpretation, and keeps one core mechanism with one lightweight modifier.
